thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: high 5xx rate detected on inference-eu-2 (model-runner). Error rate 5xx -> 17% over 5m, p95 latency +2.1s. Paging oncall @oncall-alex. Cluster: dedicated-redwood-eu2. Runbook: /runbooks/runtime-5xx
oncall-alex: ack, I'm on it. DM if you need pager-bridge.
sre-jordan: joining. can you paste the recent stderr/stdout and dmesg?
oncall-alex: copying logs from node-3:
```
[2026-03-17T10:02:12Z] model-runner[pid=2145]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8c1a2b in quant_kernel.so
[2026-03-17T10:02:12Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2145 (model-runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
[2026-03-17T10:02:12Z] model-runner: killed by signal 6
... repeated kernel backtraces ...
```
eng-runtime: looks like quant attention kernel hits a double-free when kvcache grows past threshold. I'm going to push a temporary config to disable quant kernels on impacted nodes and enable kernel fallback.
support-maya: customer-impact: support dashboard shows ~12% 5xx for tenants on large-chat model-v2 in EU. We have two incoming tickets from ACMEcorp with timeouts.
product-ops-tess: pinged ACMEcorp and beta tenants, recommending fallback to model-v1 for traffic-shift.
sre-jordan: mitigation plan: cordon node-3, drain workloads, restart runtime. also set env KERNEL_FALLBACK=1 for model-runner statefulset as a canary to 2 nodes.
oncall-alex: running drain:
$ kubectl drain node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
> evicted 12 pods, restart model-runner with new env on 2 canary pods
eng-runtime: rolling update in progress:
$ kubectl set env sts/model-runner KERNEL_FALLBACK=1 -n inference-eu
Enabling verbose kvcache logs for observation.
incident-bot: Alert update: error rate down to 6% after initial mitigations. p95 latency trending down. Continue observation 15m.
ops-dan: observed KV cache growth spikes correlated with long-context (>8k tokens) requests. Applying per-request guard: max_sequence=2048 for EU region (temporary).
eng-ml-rita: I'll open PR for a memory-bounds check in quant kernel and unit tests. ETA: next-day patch + canary. This is a kernel-level bug.
support-maya: ACMEcorp updated: "thanks, fallback helped, we'll monitor" :thumbsup:. Notifying other affected customers.
sre-jordan: recommend collecting heap/core dumps before decommissioning node-3 for postmortem. Also capture model-runner logs from restart window.
oncall-alex: capturing heapdump:
$ gcore -o /tmp/model-runner.dump 2145
Uploading to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/4332109999/model-runner.dump
incident-bot: Severity updated Sev2 -> Sev3 (reduced impact). Next steps: collect traces, file INF-4923, runbook followups.
eng-runtime: will keep KERNEL_FALLBACK enabled for 1h after stabilization, then remove if healthy. Opening INF ticket INF-4923 for follow-up.
product-ops-tess: preparing customer comms and incident timeline for post-incident note.
sre-jordan: last check: error rate steady at ~1.2% for 10m. Closing active mitigation. Handoff to eng-runtime for follow-ups and postmortem.
oncall-alex: thanks all — handing off to eng-runtime. /me marks thread resolved-ish :white_check_mark:
